name: Ananya Sharma
text: The A2 milk tastes exactly like what we had at my grandmother's farm. Glass bottle delivery is such a premium touch — I'll never go back to supermarket milk.

name: Rohan Mehta
text: I subscribed to the weekly milk plan and it has genuinely changed mornings for my family. Always on time, always fresh, always cold.

name: Priya Nair
text: The bilona ghee is unreal — the aroma fills the whole kitchen. A little pricey but you can taste the quality. Worth every rupee.

name: Karthik Reddy
text: Paneer so soft it melts in your mouth. 30-minute delivery is not a marketing gimmick — it actually arrives that fast.

name: Meera Iyer
text: I love that I can track the farm my milk comes from. The transparency and the farm story section made me trust them instantly.

name: Aditya Verma
text: The app itself feels premium — smooth, fast and beautiful. But it's the product quality that keeps me ordering every week.
